_README: T1 forward (Claude -> Codex): the 'codex' server below. setup.sh merges it into the
project-root .mcp.json ONLY when gptbridge.enabled && gptbridge.codex.enabled AND
`codex` is on PATH. Prerequisite (one-time): install Codex CLI + `codex login`
(runs on your existing ChatGPT subscription; no API spend). If `codex` is not a
Tool timeout: Codex agentic turns exceed Claude Code's default MCP tool timeout;
set MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT=300000 (ms) in .claude/settings.json 'env' for real turns.
For consult use, run Codex with its read-only sandbox so the counterpart cannot
mutate the repo either (sandbox=read-only in ~/.codex/config.toml or per-call).
T3 (adopt, don't build) alternatives are listed under _t3_model_consult; they are
documentation only (need OPENAI_API_KEY / metered spend) — not merged by setup.

_t3_model_consult._note: Copy one entry into .mcp.json manually to enable a stateless/threaded GPT second-opinion. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment (setup never writes keys to disk). Metered API spend, unlike T1/T2 which ride subscriptions.
